messages:
Ayesha (Finance): Quick heads-up — we plan to start a bucketed pricing canary for Enterprise next week. Need sign-off on grandfathering rules, invoice handling for mid-cycle group moves, and the billing runbook. Looping in @Marta @Liam.

Marta (Product): Can you summarize the deltas from current pricing? Also what's the proposed canary size? :eyes: 

Ayesha (Finance): Short: we introduce 3 token buckets with step discounts at 100k and 1M tokens; enterprise tier keeps seat fees. Grandfathering: existing customers get old rates for 90 days after migration or until contract renewal, whichever is sooner. Canary proposal: 10% of eligible enterprise accounts, then 25% ramp. Need to confirm how invoices should be computed if a customer switches A/B mid-month.

Liam (Billing Ops): For mid-month moves we have two options: prorate by days or bill by actual usage buckets after the month closes (recon). Pragmatic approach: bill provisional based on assignment days, then run a recon pass and issue adjustments if needed. If we do recon-only finalization, that simplifies invoices but increases post-bill adjustments. My preference: provisional invoice + monthly reconciliation.

Liam (Billing Ops): Example price mapping (for clarity):
```
plan,token_threshold,price_per_1k
Enterprise,0,0.80
Enterprise,100000,0.65
Enterprise,1000000,0.45
```

Sam (Eng): FYI the billing export has the zero-usage row bug (ticket #3456) — this will break the recon script if we expect contiguous token buckets. Quick fix is to emit normalized_usage in the export; SQL patch I dropped in the ticket: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, COALESCE(tokens, 0) AS normalized_usage, assigned_bucket FROM billing.exports WHERE month = $1;
```
I can ship the export change today if we agree.

Olivia (Legal): For grandfathering language we need a short clause in the customer email and the invoice policy. Suggested minimal wording: "Existing customers will retain their current per-token rates for 90 days following migration to the new pricing buckets or until their contract renews." Do we want opt-in or automatic? Legal prefers automatic with opt-out available.

Marta (Product): Canary sizing sounds fine. Acceptance criteria: 1) no >1.5% net revenue delta vs baseline in the canary cohort, 2) <0.5% increase in support tickets about billing, 3) recon script produces zero adjustments for 95% of accounts. If those hold, we ramp.

Ayesha (Finance): On adjustments: prefer issuing corrected invoices for material deltas (> $50) and credits for micro-corrections (< $5). For $5-$50 we can choose either but prefer credits for speed. Liam, can your team draft the runbook: provisional invoice flow, recon window, thresholds, and customer comms templates?

Liam (Billing Ops): Yep — I'll draft the runbook and post it in /docs by EOD tomorrow. One vendor question: will our billing gateway support producing 'corrected' invoice numbers rather than standalone credit memos? Need to confirm with Stripe/Chargebee integration.

Ayesha (Finance): Good call. If gateway cannot produce corrected numbers, we'll formalize credit memos + explanatory invoice. Please note vendor answer will change the ops steps.

billing-bot: Scheduled "price-rollout-canary" for 2025-01-30T09:00:00Z on namespace prod-billing. (job id: br-rollout-2025-01-30)

Sam (Eng): Deployed the export change to staging. Ran sample recon on a 500-account slice, fixed format mismatch.

Liam (Billing Ops): Quick poll: corrected invoice (preferred) or credit memo? Reply with :one: for corrected invoice, :two: for credit memo.

Marta (Product): :one:

Olivia (Legal): :one:

Ayesha (Finance): :one: for >$50, credits for < $5, manual review in between.

Liam (Billing Ops): Got it. I'll confirm gateway capability and post the runbook link + sample customer notification copy.

Marta (Product): One more vendor question — if cloud provider changes pass-through costs (GPU hours) mid-month, that'll affect the cost model but not list prices. Finance to track cost-of-goods variance separately?

Ayesha (Finance): Yes — we'll track COGS variance in the monthly close and maintain a separate margin dashboard per cohort.

Sam (Eng): If anyone wants the staging recon results I can drop the CSV in #eng-sre.

Liam (Billing Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the runbook and vendor confirmation. :thumbsup:
